roadmap.name: Accounting Principles
roadmap.description: Understand Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and their application in financial reporting.

roadmap.name: Financial Statement Analysis
roadmap.description: Analyze balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements to assess a company's financial health.

roadmap.name: Tax Law Fundamentals
roadmap.description: Gain a foundational understanding of U.S. tax laws and regulations.

roadmap.name: Tax Compliance
roadmap.description: Learn how to prepare and file tax returns accurately and efficiently.

roadmap.name: Financial Modeling
roadmap.description: Develop skills in building financial models for forecasting and valuation.

roadmap.name: Auditing
roadmap.description: Understand auditing procedures and techniques for ensuring the accuracy of financial records.

roadmap.name: Pass CPA Exam
roadmap.description: Successfully pass all four sections of the Uniform CPA Examination.

goals.name: Have more endurance
current_quests: Go for a run once a week

roadmap.name: Zone 2 Base Building
roadmap.description: Develop a strong aerobic base through consistent low-intensity steady-state cardio, primarily focusing on Zone 2 heart rate range. This builds mitochondrial efficiency and improves overall stamina.

roadmap.name: Form and Mobility Stability
roadmap.description: Improve movement quality and joint stability through targeted mobility drills and corrective exercises. This enhances biomechanics and reduces injury risk during Zone 2 training.

roadmap.name: Lactate Threshold Training
roadmap.description: Increase lactate threshold through interval training incorporating tempo runs and threshold intervals. This improves the body's ability to clear lactate and sustain higher intensities.

roadmap.name: VO2 Max Intervals
roadmap.description: Develop peak aerobic capacity through short, high-intensity interval training sessions. This increases VO2 max and improves the body's ability to utilize oxygen.

roadmap.name: Run 5K in 20 Minutes
roadmap.description: Achieve a sub-20-minute 5K time, demonstrating significant improvements in aerobic fitness and endurance.

goals.name: Be more in tune with myself

roadmap.name: Self-Awareness
roadmap.description: Understanding your thoughts, feelings, and behaviors. Recognizing your strengths and weaknesses.

roadmap.name: Mindfulness Practice
roadmap.description: Regularly focusing on the present moment without judgment. Techniques include meditation and mindful breathing.

roadmap.name: Emotional Regulation
roadmap.description: Developing the ability to manage and respond to emotions constructively, rather than reactively.

roadmap.name: Values Clarification
roadmap.description: Identifying and understanding your core values – the principles that guide your decisions and actions.

roadmap.name: Increased Wellbeing
roadmap.description: Experiencing a greater sense of happiness, fulfillment, and overall life satisfaction through conscious self-understanding and aligned action.

goals.name: Be able to talk to more people

roadmap.name: Conversation Starters
roadmap.description: Learn various techniques for initiating conversations, including open-ended questions and observation-based comments.

roadmap.name: Active Listening
roadmap.description: Develop skills in fully understanding and responding to others' messages, both verbal and nonverbal.

roadmap.name: Empathy
roadmap.description: Cultivate the ability to understand and share the feelings of another.

roadmap.name: Rapport Building
roadmap.description: Establish a sense of connection and trust with others through shared experiences and mutual understanding.

roadmap.name: Vulnerability
roadmap.description: Share personal experiences and feelings appropriately to foster deeper connections.

roadmap.name: Nonverbal Communication
roadmap.description: Understand and utilize body language, facial expressions, and tone of voice to enhance communication.

roadmap.name: Deep Dive Questions
roadmap.description: Ask questions that encourage others to elaborate and share more about themselves.

roadmap.name: Host a Networking Event
roadmap.description: Successfully organize and execute a networking event with at least 30 attendees, facilitating meaningful connections.
